title: Make scheduled acceptance tests independent of the host scheduler environment
outcome: Scheduled acceptance tests that leave the thread-local override unset can pick up TERMAL_ACCEPTANCE_SCHEDULER_SESSION_ID from the host. Claim-loss and first-intake cases can fail with the invalid configuration error before reaching their assertions. Make no scheduler the explicit test default and preserve intentional configured-scheduler cases.
acceptance: Scheduled acceptance test fixtures have deterministic scheduler behavior even when the surrounding host sets an invalid scheduler value, and explicitly configured fixture cases still exercise release.
